summary: Project now includes making the deployed version publicly discoverable via a small landing page.

existing_features.title: Add a small, publicly accessible landing page at route "/" that introduces Foam Daddy and provides clear calls-to-action to (1) view products and (2) request a quote.

Move the current StorefrontPage (products browsing experience) off of "/" to a dedicated public route (e.g., "/products"), and update all internal navigation links so users can still easily browse products from the header/footer and from the landing page.
Update public-facing HTML metadata to better support discovery when the site is shared/bookmarked (title and description), keeping all user-facing text in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a small landing page to make the app publicly discoverable
